name: Inbox Analytics
tagline: Inbound vs outbound message volume over time across every channel, and a zip export of every conversation.
description: Crawls your Chatfuel inbox into your own Supabase project, charts inbound and outbound messages per minute, hour, day, week or month, and exports every conversation as JSON, readable transcripts and a CSV index in one zip.

screenshots.alt: Overview: sync card reading conversations, and the messages-over-time chart with inbound and outbound lines per day over 30 days
Overview with the hour bucket over 7 days: inbound and outbound messages per hour in Europe/Berlin

Summary tiles — messages, active and new conversations, messages per conversation, median first response, median response, share answered by automation — above the channel, sender and busiest-hours cards
Breakdown cards: messages by channel, outbound by sender with shares, and messages by hour of day with the busiest hour
Export view: conversations and messages in the window, the Download zip button, and what the zip contains

provides.name: Overview
provides.description: Inbound vs outbound message counts per minute, hour, day, week or month, with summary metrics and breakdowns — plain React in your repository.

provides.name: Export
provides.description: Every conversation as JSON and a readable transcript, plus contacts.csv and manifest.json, zipped in the browser.

provides.name: Sync routes
provides.description: A server-side crawler that stores message history in your Supabase project, behind the same auth gate as every other request.
